# IconButton

Round icon-only button, close, menu, play, mute, theme toggle. label is required (it becomes the aria-label).

`AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.IconButton` · Core

## Use

```jsx
<AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.IconButton label="…">…</AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.IconButton>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.IconButton" label="…">…</x-import>
```

## Notes

Round icon-only button (close, play, menu, theme toggle). 44px default hit target.

## Props (IconButtonProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` * | `string` | Accessible name, required. |
| `variant` | `'primary' \| 'ink' \| 'secondary' \| 'ghost' \| 'onInk'` | @default "secondary" |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | 36 / 44 / 52px. @default "md" |
| `active` | `boolean` | Ghost only: pressed/active tint. @default false |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Dim and block interaction. @default false |
| `loading` | `boolean` | Spinner replaces the icon; interaction blocked. @default false |
| `loadingLabel` | `string` | Screen-reader text while loading. @default "Loading" |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` | The icon. |

_Also accepts: React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>._
